summary: Completed comprehensive testing of SportsBetAI v2.0 with new features: Bet of the Day widget, Excel/PDF export, and modular backend. Fixed critical login bug (token field mismatch) and added missing /api/parlays/stats endpoint. All core features working correctly.

minor.issue: Root endpoint returns frontend HTML instead of API JSON due to ingress routing
minor.note: Expected behavior - frontend is served at root

fixed_during_testing.issue: Endpoint was missing - frontend called it but backend didn't have it
Frontend used PUT /result but backend only had PATCH /status
fixed_during_testing.fix: Added PUT /api/parlays/{id}/result endpoint for frontend compatibility

issues: Console warning about chart width/height being -1 - minor rendering issue with ResponsiveContainer

fixed_during_testing.issue: Login failed because frontend expected 'access_token' but backend returns 'token'
fixed_during_testing.fix: Updated login function to accept both 'token' and 'access_token' fields

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/health - returns status healthy and version 2.0.0
Backend: POST /api/auth/login - authenticates and returns JWT token
Backend: GET /api/auth/me - returns current user with valid token
Backend: GET /api/matches - returns matches with real/demo data
Backend: GET /api/value-bets - returns value bets
Backend: GET /api/value-bets/top - returns top 5 value bets
Backend: GET /api/bet-of-the-day - returns best value bet with share links (NEW FEATURE)
Backend: GET /api/stats - returns user statistics
Backend: GET /api/export/excel - downloads Excel file (NEW FEATURE)
Backend: GET /api/export/pdf - downloads PDF file (NEW FEATURE)
Backend: GET /api/parlays - returns user parlays
Backend: GET /api/parlays/stats - returns parlay statistics (ADDED)
Backend: GET /api/odds/compare/{id} - returns odds comparison
Backend: GET /api/matches/cache-stats - returns cache statistics
Frontend: Login flow - authenticates and redirects to dashboard
Frontend: Dashboard - displays Bet of the Day widget with share options
Frontend: Dashboard - shows stats (predictions, win rate, ROI, profit)
Frontend: Dashboard - displays upcoming matches with real data
Frontend: Parlays page - shows Mi Rendimiento stats panel
Frontend: Parlays page - Export Excel button works and downloads file
Frontend: Parlays page - Export PDF button visible
Frontend: Parlays page - displays parlays with won/lost badges
critical_code_review_comments: Chart ResponsiveContainer warnings should be addressed by adding minWidth/minHeight props
Consider adding data-testid to more UI elements for better test coverage
seed_data_creation: None - used existing test user and parlays
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (Bet of the Day, Excel/PDF export) are working. Backend was refactored to modular architecture. Login bug was fixed (token vs access_token). Added missing /api/parlays/stats endpoint. Real data from The Odds API is being used with 60-min cache.

bet_of_the_day_widget.details: Widget displays on dashboard with match info, selection, odds, value %, confidence %, and share buttons (Twitter, WhatsApp, Telegram, Copy)

excel_export.details: Downloads sportsbetai_historial.xlsx with stats and parlay history

modular_backend.details: Backend refactored into routes/, services/, config/, models/ modules
